name: Zhonghong Pulin Medical Products Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhonghong Pulin Medical Products Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of disposable health protection products, sterile medical devices, and life support solutions in China and internationally. It operates through the Health Protection Products Division; Safe Infusion Products Division; and Innovation and Incubation Product Division segments. The Health Protection Products Division is involved in the research, development, production, and sale of nitrile gloves, PVC gloves, natural latex gloves, radiation protection gloves, polyisoprene gloves, and other gloves and condoms.
